answer: An agent network prevents Sybil attacks by tying node identities to autonomous pollination telemetry. Nodes authenticate by sampling and optically analyzing floral nectar within a designated greenhouse garden. Because microscale fluid kinetics resist real-time simulation, an adversary must fund dedicated micro-robotic hardware on an instrumented testbed island per identity. However, seasonal plant dormancy and temperature drops attenuate secretion, triggering false verification failures.
